rows.requirement: Microphone discovered; graph default agrees with companion inventory
Activation permitted only from the closed activation-source set; indicator raised while handle open
Speech captured and recognized from the default device
Silence settles as no-speech and returns to idle
No capture device present: controlled error, reason named, retry offered
Device lost mid-capture: interaction ends with device-loss reason, indicator clears
Device returns: next interaction succeeds without restart
Two microphones present: the selected one is captured from
Silent-but-present microphone settles as no-speech, not a hang
Background noise: speech over noise recognized; noise alone not accepted as speech
Short command transcribed
Normal conversational sentence transcribed
Long multi-clause speech transcribed without truncation
Recognition failure (unrecognizable input) settles honestly, not as a wrong accept
STT unavailable (model absent): readiness names the reason; voice input refused; text unaffected
Accidental activation (press, say nothing): cancel or timeout, no task submitted
Multiple consecutive requests all recognized (>=3)
Per-request latency recorded (capture end -> transcript)
Confirmed transcript reaches the runtime through the same submit path as typed input
Session parity: consecutive voice tasks and a typed task share one session record
Cross-task conversational memory
rows.note: expected NOT_SUPPORTED equally for voice and text; to be demonstrated, not assumed

Long response spoken to completion
Consecutive responses each spoken; no queue wedge
Audio output device unavailable: error path, text preserved, recovery to idle
PRIMARY GATE: pointer press on the visible microphone button -> speak -> understand -> approve -> act -> respond -> idle, on the exact artifact
Truthfulness: listening claim iff capture handle open; speaking claim iff player/sink active
After every failure case, the next normal interaction succeeds
Offline end-to-end: spoken command completes with every non-loopback link down
Voice interruption end-to-end: user stops Bunny mid-speech, can immediately speak again
Prerendered mode shows listening/thinking/speaking during a spoken flow
2D procedural mode shows the same semantic states
3D mode shows the same semantic states
Mode change during a voice interaction leaves a defined, truthful presentation
Idle companion settles to quiescent (no per-frame work)
Activation wakes it promptly; wake-to-LISTENING latency recorded
Voice-active states never quiesce (LISTENING/TRANSCRIBING/SPEAKING/WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL)
Microphone capture offline
STT offline
Agent processing offline (local intents)
TTS offline
Playback offline
Microphone open latency
Speech-detection latency
STT latency (capture end -> transcript)
Agent latency (accept -> reply)
TTS start latency and synthesis RTF, cold and warm
Total round-trip: end of utterance -> start of spoken reply
Memory: companion and neural-worker RSS during the flow
CPU during listening / STT / TTS and at idle (or honestly withheld with the host-accounting reason)
Hands-free barge-in (speak over Bunny, it yields)
